rules.name: Search Engine Discovery of Sensitive Content
rules.description: Detects search engine crawlers accessing sensitive paths like /admin, /.env, /.git, /wp-admin, /backup, /config
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent, AzureDiagnostics | where Message contains "wstg" or Message contains "information-gathering" | summarize count(), make_set(SourceIP) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), ActivityDisplayName | where count_ > 3

rules.name: Web Server Fingerprinting via Headers
